upload.fdiDesc: Upload the Georgian FDI-by-country-by-sector XLSX file. The file must have a header row with "ქვეყნის კოდი" in column A, then one block per country (code, name, "სულ" row, sector sub-rows). Values may be in mln or thousand USD — each period column's unit is detected automatically and the table always shows mln USD.
upload.companiesDesc: Upload the active-companies XLSX file. Column S contains the active flag (blank = inactive), column V lists the capital-origin countries separated by " / ". The file is parsed in your browser; only the small aggregated summary is sent to the server.

welcome.title: Welcome to Vector Portal
welcome.desc: This short tour walks you through your workspace — from daily events and documents to statistics. Use Next to continue, or press Esc to exit at any time.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.desc: Use the sidebar to move between your Dashboard and Statistics. Your profile and the language switch also live here.

hero.title: Your day at a glance
hero.desc: A personal greeting, today's date and the current time in Tbilisi.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.desc: Your calendar lives here: days with scheduled events are highlighted — click a day to preview what is planned.

upcoming.title: Overview panel
upcoming.desc: This side panel gathers your notifications and quick actions for the selected day.

create.title: Create an event
create.desc: Start a new event here: participants, the document submitter and the schedule. Click Next to open the form and walk through its fields.

templates.title: Templates
templates.desc: Reusable event templates save time when the same meeting format repeats.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: New activity lands here — documents awaiting your action, returned sections and ready documents. The badge shows unread items.

toggle.title: In progress vs completed
toggle.desc: Switch between documents that are still in progress and those already completed.

search.title: Search
search.desc: Filter the list below by keyword — event titles, countries or participants.

cards.title: Your events and documents
cards.desc: Each card is an event with its document. The coloured chips show the status: green — ready, yellow — in preparation, grey — not started. Click a card to open the document.

gotoStats.title: On to Statistics
gotoStats.desc: The Statistics page builds country reports — trade, tourism, investments and more. Click Next to go there and continue the tour.

welcome.title: Creating an event
welcome.desc: This is the event creation form. Let's walk through each field — afterwards you can fill it in for real.

title.title: Title
title.desc: A short, clear name for the event — this is how it appears in lists and notifications.

country.title: Country
country.desc: The country the visit or meeting concerns.

docType.title: Document type
docType.desc: Discussion Points is the default — it always leads to a meeting, so the meeting date becomes required. Choose Other for any other document.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.desc: Simple sends the document through a short chain; Advanced adds the full review chain.

dsRole.title: Document submitter
dsRole.desc: Choose which role prepares the document; extra fields appear for picking the specific person.

language.title: Language
language.desc: The working language of the document.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.desc: The date the document must be ready.

meetingTime.title: Meeting date & time
meetingTime.desc: When the meeting takes place. Required for Discussion Points documents.

curator.title: Curator
curator.desc: Whether a curator must be assigned to the document.

task.title: Task
task.desc: A free-form description of the assignment for the participants.

attachment.title: Attachments
attachment.desc: Attach reference files for the participants.

template.title: Template
template.desc: Start from a saved template to pre-fill the sections.

sections.title: Sections
sections.desc: The document's sections and the departments responsible for each one. Add as many as needed.

save.title: Create
save.desc: When everything is filled in, this button creates the event and notifies the participants.

finish.title: Back to the tour
finish.desc: That's the create-event form. We'll close it now and continue the tour.

welcome.title: Statistics
welcome.desc: Here you generate up-to-date economic reports for any country. Let's look at the controls.

mode.title: Report mode
mode.desc: Choose between the latest single-country report, a country comparison, or product statistics.

country.title: Pick a country
country.desc: Start typing to search for a country and select it for the report.

reportLang.title: Report language
reportLang.desc: Reports can be produced in Georgian or English, independently of the site language.

generate.title: Generate
generate.desc: Builds the full report with tables and charts. Click Next — the tour will pick China and generate a live report to explore.

tabs.title: Report sections
tabs.desc: Jump between trade, tourism, investments, companies and the appendix.

export.title: Export
export.desc: Download the generated report as a PDF or Word file to share it further.

trade.title: Trade
trade.desc: The trade section opens with a summary — turnover, exports and imports with the selected country.

tradeCharts.title: Trade charts
tradeCharts.desc: Turnover and dynamics are also drawn as charts — hover over them to inspect the values.

overview.title: Trade overview
overview.desc: Turnover, exports, imports and the balance — the previous year against the current period.

exportTable.title: Exports by product
exportTable.desc: What Georgia exports to the country, by product group.

exportMovers.title: Export movers
exportMovers.desc: The product groups whose exports grew or fell the most.

importTable.title: Imports by product
importTable.desc: What Georgia imports from the country, by product group.

importMovers.title: Import movers
importMovers.desc: The product groups whose imports grew or fell the most.

tourism.title: Tourism
tourism.desc: Visitor numbers from the country, side by side as a table and a chart.

investments.title: Investments
investments.desc: Foreign direct investment by period, with the sector breakdown below.

fdiSectors.title: Investment sectors
fdiSectors.desc: Which sectors the country's investments go into.

companies.title: Companies
companies.desc: How many companies from the country are registered and active in Georgia.

appendix.title: Appendix
appendix.desc: The detailed data tables behind the report.

finish.title: That's the tour!
finish.desc: You now know your way around Vector Portal. Click the “?” button in the sidebar any time to replay this tour.

method.title: How the ratings are made
method.screening: A rating is a screening result, not a forecast. It ranks where a product Georgia already exports looks easiest to sell, using trade figures alone. Every number below comes from the method's configuration file.
method.gate1: Georgia's domestic exports of the product (re-exports excluded, Geostat) must average at least {min} a year over the latest {years} full years and be above zero in each of them. Products that fail are not shown.
method.gate2Established: {n} or more consecutive years of imports ending at the data year: established market, rated on a {w}-year window.
method.gate2New: {a} or {b} consecutive years: rated on those years only and labelled "new market".
method.gate2Watch: {a} or {b} years: listed under "Markets to watch", not rated.
method.scoringIntro: Four blocks add up to 100 points. All averages are simple averages over the window.
method.demandSizeTitle: Demand size ({max} points): average yearly imports
method.growthText: Partner growth is the yearly rate between the first and last year of the window; world growth is computed the same way from world imports. Group A: partner growth positive and above world growth. Group B: everything else. The net change over the last two years then sets the points.
method.growthA_nonneg: Group A, two-year change of zero or more
method.growthA_small: Group A, decline of less than {v}
method.growthA_steep: Group A, decline of {v} or more
method.growthB_above: Group B, change above zero and imports in the data year above the window average
method.growthB_below: Group B, change above zero and imports at or below the window average
method.growthB_nonpos: Group B, change of zero or less
method.competitionText: Deficit share for a year is (imports − exports) ÷ imports. Supplier concentration is the sum of squared supplier shares of the partner's imports over the window (0 to 1). Competitors' tariff is the import-weighted average of what the partner's other suppliers face. Average supplier distance is import-weighted.
method.deficit_deficit: Average imports at least {r}× average exports
method.deficit_surplus: Average exports at least {r}× average imports
method.trendCurrent: Deficit share in the data year at or above the year before
method.trendPrevious: Deficit share the year before at or above the year before that
method.tariff_lower: Georgia's tariff lower than the competitors' average
method.tariff_equal: Equal (within {v} percentage points), also the default when tariff data is missing
method.distance_fit: Georgia's distance to the partner at or below the average supplier distance
method.positionText: RCA = (Georgia's domestic exports of the product ÷ Georgia's total domestic exports) ÷ (world exports of the product ÷ world total exports), each averaged over Geostat's latest {years} full years. Georgia's share of the partner's imports and of world exports are computed over the window.
method.track: Track record: Georgia's domestic exports to the partner above zero in at least {n} of the last {k} years
method.headroom: Headroom: Georgia's share of the partner's imports below its share of world exports
method.ratingLow: Low: under {n} points, or gate 1 failed
method.capsTitle: Caps applied after the points are added
method.capSmall: Small market: average imports under {v} cannot rate above {r}.
method.capSteep: Steep recent decline: a two-year net change of {v} or worse cannot rate High.
method.limitCif: Imports are reported including freight and insurance and exports excluding them, so the deficit and headroom figures slightly overstate imports.
method.limitTariff: Where tariff data is missing the pair is scored as Equal and flagged on the row.
method.limitSources: Each partner is scored on its own data year and a single trade source; sources are never mixed inside one window.
method.limitRaw: Only derived figures are shown. Raw trade records are not published or downloadable.
method.limitScreening: The point values and cut-offs are starting values that will be calibrated against how exports actually developed.
